name: image-to-code
description: Open the bundled ImageToCode Annotator and hand off annotated images into code-ready assets.

interface.longDescription: Includes a self-contained ImageToCode Annotator web app for Codex's right-side browser and orchestrates its HandoffBundles into code-ready assets and Flutter pages.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the ImageToCode Annotator in the Codex right-side browser.
